reason: I've never heard of them, there's nothing here from real customers, and it doesn't say anything about shipping costs or returns. I've been burned on sizes enough that I won't hand over $38+ to an unknown brand online.
objection: No reviews or real-customer photos, no size info, and nothing about shipping cost or free returns. If the fit is off I'm stuck paying to send it back.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns and free or cheap shipping stated clearly, plus a bunch of real customer reviews and photos with sizing details so I can see how the boxy fit actually looks on people my size.
